description: This file provides utilities for interacting with the OpenTripMap API, including functions to obtain an API key, fetch JSON data with error handling, and retrieve attractions within a specified radius. It includes configuration management and debugging support for development environments.

methods.name: getApiKey()
methods.description: Resolves and returns the OpenTripMap API key from environment variables.

methods.name: getJson(url, { missingKeyHint } = {})
methods.description: Performs a fetch request to retrieve JSON data, with enhanced error handling including authentication detection.

methods.name: fetchAttractionsByRadius({ lat, lon, radius = 3000, kinds = "interesting_places", limit = 30 })
methods.description: Fetches a list of attractions within a given radius around specified coordinates, returning formatted attraction data.
